text:
Alex: Quick sync — we need to coordinate version bumps for v0.14.0 across api, runtime, console, and SDKs. Cutoff is tomorrow 10:00am PT. Any planned breaking changes or blockers?

Morgan: No breaking API changes on my end. PR ready that updates the endpoint docs and swagger: https://github.com/redwood/inference-api/pull/1234. Needs one more review for the examples.

Samir: Runtime has a small ABI flag change that alters engine init ordering. I will open the runtime PR in ~2h. It should be semver-minor but it requires console to point to the new runtime tag.

Priya: JS & Go SDKs: I'll update package.json and go.mod after the runtime tag is final. Any schema changes I should know about? If not I can cut PRs today.

Alex: No schema changes. This is purely version alignment + small opt-in flag in runtime. Please keep it to minor bumps so we don't trigger downstream codegen churn. Also update changelogs for each repo (short bullet item).

release-bot: Release checklist reminder: 
- Update version in package files
- Add changelog entry in CHANGELOG.md
- Open/assign PRs for cross-repo bumps
- Run e2e and smoke tests (runtime, api, console)
- Cut release branch (release/v0.14.0)
- Tag and publish
Commands: `git grep "0.13.0" -n || true` 
Example cut: `git checkout -b release/v0.14.0 && git push origin release/v0.14.0`

Lina: I can cut the release branch after all PRs are merged. Who has permission to cut tags and publish images? @Alex @Morgan ?

Morgan: I can do the branch cut and tag, and publish npm for console assets. For runtime docker images I can coordinate with infra or Samir to push to the registry.

Samir: Opened runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/567. Using interim image tag `redwood/runtime:0.14.0-rc1` until we tag. Please review pinned flags and CI. I'll also add a short migration note in runtime/CHANGELOG.md.

Priya: JS SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-js/pull/88 — bumps API client + updates changelog entry (docs link included). Go SDK PR incoming in ~30m.

Alex: Good. Action items: reviewers, please merge before T-2h. Lina will cut branch at T-30m, Morgan will tag and publish, Samir will push runtime image. Priya will bump SDKs and update release notes.

Alex: Quick helper command to find lingering old versions when checking repos: 
```
# find hardcoded 0.13.0
for r in api runtime console sdk-js sdk-go; do
  git -C ../$r grep -R "0.13.0" || true
done
```

Lina: Acknowledged. I'll watch merges and run the smoke canary post-cut. If anything slips, we fallback to previous runtime tag for console.

Morgan: I'll queue the canary after tag — will monitor latency dashboards and escalate if errors > 0.5% 5xx.

Alex: Thanks all — ping here when PRs are merged. :thumbsup:
